WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) AS rate
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count,
  AVG(ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate - mr.rate) AS average_amount_above_mean
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate > mr.rate;
